args.title: Announce error toasts assertively and keep them until dismissed
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Change error toasts to use an assertive live region for immediate screen reader announcement and prevent automatic dismissal so they remain until manually dismissed. This makes error messages more accessible and noticeable for users who need more time to respond.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is that error toasts are announced with a polite live region and auto-dismiss after five seconds, which can delay screen reader announcement and cause users to miss errors if slow. The responsible file is src/components/Toast.tsx, where toasts are managed with a polite aria-live region and a fixed auto-dismiss timer. The fix is to use an assertive aria-live for error toasts and prevent them from auto-dismissing so they stay visible until dismissed by the user.
